text.tspan: Route /staff/admin/accounts. Who can sign in to the staff portal.

g.text: Lumina Specialized Hospital · UI wireframes v0.1 · October 2026

text.tspan: Add an admin, front-desk or doctor account.
Three roles: admin (everything), front desk (the front
desk only), doctor (their own patients only).
A doctor account is linked to one doctor profile, so
the doctor sees only their own list.
